$ ast secrets create T08_PROBE --value probe-value --description "T0.8 vault probe, deleted after"
  Created secret "T08_PROBE"
  Updated              Name       Type
  <timestamp>          T08_PROBE  secret

  (note: a first attempt with a dashed name was rejected:
  variable name must start with a letter or underscore and contain only
  letters, digits, or underscores)

$ ast secrets list
  Updated              Name       Type
  <timestamp>          T08_PROBE  secret

$ ast secrets get T08_PROBE
  Name:        T08_PROBE
  Created:     <timestamp>
  Updated:     <timestamp>
  Value:       ******
  Description: T0.8 vault probe, deleted after

$ ast secrets delete T08_PROBE
  Deleted secret "T08_PROBE"

$ ast secrets list
  No secrets found in account <account>
